ko.title: 아일랜드 유럽육상선수권 챔피언 시아라 마지언 암 투병 끝에 34세로 별세

en.title: Ireland’s European Athletics Champion Ciara Mageean Dies of Cancer at 34
en.summary: Ciara Mageean, an Irish track and field athlete who competed in two Olympics, has died at 34 after an illness.
